provenance.provider: NASA POWER (monthly point API over ocean, community=RE) + NASA GIBS
provenance.note: POWER over ocean is marine AIR temperature (T2M), not sea-surface temperature. SST comes from the GHRSST MUR layer via GIBS imagery only. Chlorophyll (PACE/MODIS ocean colour) is NOT connected — no values are shown.

imagery.label: Ocean colour · not connected
imagery.note: PACE/MODIS ocean-colour is a planned connector. No values or imagery are shown rather than a placeholder that could be mistaken for data.
